summary: The guest gives a slow, unconvinced reply, then turns his head away with a sidelong look and asks which region.
framing: Medium close-up, eye level, of the guest seated, chest up; same setup as S25; static camera. A champagne flute stands at the far left edge, burger tops along the bottom edge.

hamburgers on the platter along the bottom edge
red chair back behind the guest

head back to level, mouth narrows
mouth closed, level stare at the host
eyes fully closed, head still 3/4 right
head turns toward camera: nearly full-face, slightly tilted, lids half-open, small round mouth
head continues round to 3/4 left, eyes open, brows lowering
head settled 3/4 left, turned away from the host; pupils slid to the right corners of the eyes for a sidelong look back at him, brows low and straight; shoulders unchanged; held to the cut, speaking

notes: Camera static, agrees with timeline.json. On twos, new drawings on odd frames.
